title: Test environment
startupTimeout: Startup did not complete within 20 minutes (installation, build or launch). The application process was stopped; test logs and volumes remain available until the environment is stopped, recreated or expires.
emptyHelp: Choose the availability duration, then click Start above. Containers and logs will appear here once the environment is running.
emptyReadOnly: Ask an administrator to start this environment. Its containers and logs will then appear here.
containerList: Containers — up to three visible rows
containersUnavailable: Unable to inspect the environment’s containers.
terminalUnavailable: Unable to open a shell in this container. No fallback shell was started elsewhere.
terminalDisconnected: Terminal disconnected. Return to Logs, then reopen Terminal to create a new session. Input was not replayed.
agentManaged: Let agents prepare and manage their test environment
agentManagedHelp: Standing authorization scoped to this project: agents can prepare their own recipe and launch a preview through MCP without confirmation on every start. They cannot enable this setting themselves. When disabled, the manual profile is used.
agentRuntimes: Allowed agent technologies (application and test services)
agentLimitsHelp: The limits below apply to each application. Up to three temporary services can use these technologies (256 MiB each). Agents supply test data only; manual-profile variables and production secrets are never inherited.
waitingForHttp: Process started — waiting for a valid HTTP response
settingsDescription: Define how to install, build and start this project. Each agent gets an isolated environment from its current files, including uncommitted changes.
setupRequired: An administrator must enable the service: approved images, wildcard domain, HTTPS certificate and proxy routing. No test application port is published on the host.
enable: Allow test environments for this project
directory: Project directory (relative to the agent’s working copy)
storageLimits: Bounded ephemeral storage: sources and builds {{workspace}} MiB · caches {{cache}} MiB · temporary {{temporary}} MiB · data {{data}} MiB.
storageMemoryHelp: These tmpfs volumes consume runtime RAM in addition to its processes. Caches live in /cache, outside the sources. No per-user disk quota is configured. The agent terminal preflight does not measure these volumes.
storageMeasuredAt: Last runtime measurement: {{time}} (also retained after failure).
hotHelp: Sources are checked every two seconds. In hot mode, Vite and compatible servers reload changes through WebSocket. Otherwise, use process restart and refresh the page. Dependency changes may require recreating the environment.
advanced: Advanced configuration: test variables and services
services: Supporting services (JSON array: name, runtime, command, env)
secretsHelp: Use test accounts and data only. Values are encrypted at rest and hidden after saving; keep [stored] to retain an existing value. Server application cookies are isolated; reading cookies directly from JavaScript may require adaptation.
isolationHelp: No Docker socket, system files, private network or production accounts. Common sensitive files and dependencies are excluded from the copy. Test volumes and databases are ephemeral and deleted on stop or expiry.
saved: Profile saved. Recreate any running environment to apply its new configuration.
description: Test this agent’s changes at a direct URL in your normal browser. Access is personal and project-scoped; no Codex account or production secret is copied automatically.

source.label: Test environment source
source.stopFirst: Stop the environment before changing its source.
source.localOnly: Local files, including uncommitted changes. No automatic fetch, commit or push.
source.failed: Source denied or settings changed. Refresh and try again.

dependenciesChanged: Dependencies changed. Recreate the environment to run installation and build again.
copyFailed: Unable to copy the URL. You can select the address above and copy it manually.
addressHelp: This address stays the same for this agent after recreation. Open the preview from Mergeron to authorize your access; no temporary access link is copied.
recreateConfirm: Recreate this environment from the current files? Its ephemeral test data will be deleted, never the agent’s sources.
stopConfirm: Stop this environment and delete its ephemeral test data? The agent’s sources remain intact.
popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the window. Allow popups for Mergeron and try again.
lifetimeHelp: Duration starts at launch or when this change is applied. Changing it does not restart the environment. “Never” disables automatic shutdown.
prerequisitesHelp: Project authorization does not enable the server service. The following items prevent startup.
prerequisitesUnavailable: Prerequisites could not be verified. Startup remains blocked; refresh when the service is accessible.
prerequisitesBlockedHelp: Complete the prerequisites above before starting. The agent can then prepare its recipe if the project authorizes it.
prerequisiteServerDisabled: Server: enable MERGERON_PREVIEWS_ENABLED in the application and Manager.
prerequisiteDomainMissing: Server: configure MERGERON_PREVIEW_DOMAIN, wildcard DNS, an HTTPS certificate and proxy routing.
prerequisiteViewerNotReady: Server: the preview gateway is not listening. Check its activation and logs.
prerequisiteManagerUnavailable: Server: the Manager is not responding; check its health and socket connection.
prerequisiteManagerNotConfigured: Server: the Manager preview service is incomplete. Configure its domain and approved images (MERGERON_PREVIEW_IMAGES).
prerequisiteDomainMismatch: Server: the application and Manager must use the same preview domain.
prerequisiteProfileMissing: Project: save the test environment profile.
prerequisiteProfileUnreadable: Project: the stored profile cannot be read. Check its configuration and encryption key.
prerequisiteProjectDisabled: Project: authorize test environments in its settings.
prerequisiteStartMissing: Project: set the manual profile startup command.
prerequisiteAgentRuntimesMissing: Project: select at least one technology available in the Manager catalog for agents.
prerequisiteRuntimeNotAllowed: Project: the manual profile technology is not approved by the Manager.
prerequisiteServiceRuntimeNotAllowed: Project: an associated service uses a technology missing from the Manager catalog.
prerequisiteWorkingDirectoryMissing: Agent: select an available working directory in this project.
prerequisiteWorkingDirectoryProtected: Agent: its working directory is a protected system location; select a project directory.
prerequisiteWorkingDirectoryAccessDenied: Agent: access to its working directory is denied; check its reference and permissions.
prerequisiteRecipeRequired: Agent: delegation is enabled, but the agent must prepare its recipe using approved technologies before the first start.
prerequisiteNoRuntimes: No technology is available. An administrator must first declare approved images in the Manager.
prerequisiteUnknown: A prerequisite prevents startup. Contact the project administrator.
prerequisiteDockerVersion: Docker Engine 28 or later is required for test environments.
prerequisiteManagerDocker: The Manager cannot verify its Docker Engine. Check its access and logs.
prerequisiteApplicationIdentity: The Mergeron container lacks its expected managed identity. Ask the installation administrator to check its labels.
prerequisiteWorkspaceMount: The workspace mount does not match the Manager’s configured directory. Check mounts without moving data.
prerequisiteManagerIdentity: The Manager cannot find a container with its expected identity. Check its name and labels.
prerequisiteManagerVolumes: The Manager image declares volumes incompatible with test helpers. Use a compatible Manager image.
prerequisiteRuntimeImageUnsupported: An approved test image is not a compatible Linux image. Check the Manager catalog.
prerequisiteRuntimeImageMissing: An approved test image is not available locally. The administrator must load the approved digest.
prerequisiteManagerPreflight: The Manager preflight did not return a valid result. Check its version and logs.

memoryDiagnostics.title: Selected container memory diagnostics
memoryDiagnostics.sample: Total charge: {{usageBytes}} / {{limitBytes}} MiB · Anonymous: {{anonymousBytes}} · Files: {{fileBytes}} · Shared: {{sharedBytes}} MiB
memoryDiagnostics.explanation: Total charge includes tmpfs charged to this container. File and shared memory overlap: do not add them. Dependency and cache storage is detailed under Storage. No limit is increased automatically.
